nfl.oneThing: Kirk Cousins has gone from the Raiders to the Vikings, and rookie Fernando Mendoza will start at quarterback for Las Vegas this Sunday against the Seahawks.

wrap.summary: Week 9 was dominated by the trade deadline, with 18 in-season deals, including Kirk Cousins going from the Raiders to the Vikings. On the field the Chiefs and Giants won key games, while the Cowboys snatched a win from the Colts. The Raiders lost 38–17 to the 49ers before the deadline, and they will start Mendoza this week.

storylines.text: The deadline reshaped several rosters. Cousins moved to the Vikings, Downs went to the Chiefs, and Jonathan Taylor stayed with the Colts.
The Chiefs beat the Jets 35–12 to end a two-game losing streak, and the Giants beat the Eagles 19–11 to keep their two-game win streak going.
The Raiders lost 38–17 to the 49ers, and then traded Cousins to the Vikings. Mendoza's first start is the next big test for Las Vegas.
The Cardinals lost quarterback Gardner Minshew, who probably needs season-ending surgery, and top receiver Michael Wilson, who is out for the season.

headlines.title: Raiders trade Cousins, and Mendoza takes over
headlines.summary: The Raiders traded Kirk Cousins to the Vikings on deadline day for a 2027 third-round pick, pending a physical. The 2026 No. 1 overall pick, Fernando Mendoza, will start at home against the Seahawks this Sunday, with Aidan O'Connell as backup. Cousins had started nine games for the 4–5 Raiders. GM John Spytek said the team was not actively looking to trade him, and the deal came together in a phone call with Vikings GM Nolan Teasley. Coach Klint Kubiak and Spytek sat down with Cousins once a trade looked likely.
headlines.whyItMatters: They sit 1.0 game behind the last AFC playoff spot, so the next few weeks will show whether the move is about the future or the race.

headlines.title: Cardinals lose Minshew and Wilson
headlines.summary: Arizona has taken two big hits. Quarterback Gardner Minshew probably needs season-ending surgery on his right UCL, according to ESPN sources. Top receiver Michael Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture. The Cardinals have signed veteran quarterback Josh Johnson off the Bengals practice squad to help fill the gap. Arizona is 3–6 and 14th in the NFC.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Cardinals are already 3–6, and losing a top receiver and a quarterback in the same week makes the rest of their season harder. They host the Rams next Sunday.

headlines.title: Giants' Taylor deal falls through
headlines.summary: CBS reports the Giants pulled an offer of two draft picks for Colts running back Jonathan Taylor before the deadline, and Taylor stayed in Indianapolis. 'They know what I can do,' he said.
headlines.whyItMatters: Their next test is the Commanders on Thursday Night Football.

headlines.title: Chiefs add Josh Downs as the Colts keep rebuilding
headlines.summary: Kansas City traded for Colts receiver Josh Downs, who was one of two Indianapolis receivers moved before the deadline. Keenan Allen went to San Francisco for a 2027 sixth-round pick. The Chiefs beat the Jets 35–12 to end a two-game losing streak, and they are 6-2 and fifth in the AFC. The Colts are 2–7 after five straight losses, and they are third in the AFC South.
headlines.whyItMatters: Kansas City gets a receiver for the second half of the season. Indianapolis is building for the future, with Taylor and Daniel Jones still on the roster.

teamNews.title: Cousins trade and the Raiders' roster spot
teamNews.text: The Raiders' trade of Cousins to the Vikings opened a 53-man roster spot, which they filled by promoting rookie defensive tackle Tim Keenan from the practice squad. Keenan was a seventh-round pick of the Rams this year out of Alabama. He played 35 per cent of the snaps in his three elevated games, with seven tackles and a sack.

contextCard.title: How practice-squad elevations work
contextCard.body: Teams can elevate a practice-squad player to the active roster for a game without signing him to the 53-man roster. Each player has a limit on how many elevations he can get in a season. Tim Keenan reached that limit after three games, which is why the Raiders promoted him to the 53-man roster.

wrap.summary: Wembanyama's 40-point night and the Spurs' ninth straight win stood out, while the Warriors' 51-point rout of the Pelicans kept them rolling. The Lakers are 10–2 and top of the West, with the Spurs second at 9–2. The Mavericks made a late-week statement with Flagg's 43-point game.

storylines.text: The Spurs' nine-game win streak has them second in the West. Wembanyama was the main reason, with 40 points and nine blocks against the Suns.
The Warriors' eight straight wins came without Will Richard, who is out indefinitely with a torn UCL in his left thumb, and Brandon Williams is out for at least a week.
Flagg's 43 points and the Mavericks' 125–122 win over the Pacers pushed Dallas to 7–4, with Flagg adding to his history in the NBA.
Jaylen Brown was traded from Boston to Philadelphia, and a source says he never asked for a trade.
The Thunder added wing Nique Clifford from Sacramento for two second-round picks, to replace the starters they lost for months.

headlines.title: Flagg's 43 lifts Mavericks past Pacers
headlines.summary: Cooper Flagg scored 43 points with 10 rebounds, six assists and three steals as Dallas beat Indiana 125–122. Kyrie Irving added 35 points and seven threes, and P.J. Washington had 13 points and nine rebounds. Pascal Siakam scored 29 for the Pacers, who are 3–8 and 11th in the East. Flagg became the first teenager in NBA history to record five 40-point games. Dallas is 7–4 and 9th in the West.
headlines.whyItMatters: Dallas has won its last three and is in the West mix. Indiana is now without Tyrese Haliburton, who is out with a hamstring strain, and is falling further behind.

headlines.title: Warriors' eight-game streak continues with depth issues
headlines.summary: Golden State beat New Orleans 138–87 on Monday for its eighth straight win, and it is 8–3 and 4th in the West. Brandin Podziemski and Stephen Curry each scored 25 points, and Yaxel Lendeborg added 23. Brandon Williams left the game after 99 seconds with a left hamstring strain and is out for at least a week. Will Richard is out indefinitely with a torn UCL in his left thumb.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Warriors play a difficult road trip in Houston, San Antonio, New Orleans, Dallas and Memphis, and they are doing it without two bench contributors.

headlines.title: Jaylen Brown asked only to have a say in his trade
headlines.summary: A source told ESPN that Brown never requested a trade from the Celtics. He asked only to be involved in deciding where he would go, and Boston ignored that request before trading him to the 76ers. Philadelphia is 9–2 and first in the East, and it plays Boston on Tuesday. The Tatum and Brown history has been a talking point all week.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Celtics and 76ers play four times this season, so the trade and the Tatum feud will be a storyline in both cities for months.
